plant_species.description: Fan-shaped leaves gather along slender branches, their green blades edged with warm gold
a compact, rounded bush with heart shaped leaves and dusky berries
bowed stems carrying clusters of pale lavender bells
An eager vine with curling stems and honey-gold flowers. With every upward journey, it reaches for the next branch.
Glossy bronze-purple leaves hug the ground beneath short towers of blue flowers. bugle
Large ivory bracts hang from an open green crown like folded silk, lifting gently around its tiny dark flower heads.
A small, airy clump of mint-green stems that curl into loose corkscrews, Its open loops introduce a playful outline and visible space between stems, contrasting with the dense foliage
Thin ribbons of copper bark peel from its branching trunk beneath clusters of three-part leaves.
A little carpet of heart-shaped leaves and ivory flowers traced with pale pink veins. Its folded leaves open like tiny fans when the woodland wakes.
Broad, arching sage-green fronds unfurl from tightly curled shoots. Tiny beads of dew nestle along their tips, gathering wherever several Dewferns grow together

A delicate woodland plant with translucent green stems, softly toothed leaves, and hanging orange flowers speckled with crimson. As its stored dew is released, the it's bright flowers shimmer in the morning sun
Tall, gently bowed spires carry dusty rose bells with plum-speckled throats. The uppermost buds remain curled like little sleeping lanterns.
A slender tree with featherlike leaves and clustered coral berries. Each berry carries a warm ember-coloured centre, bringing a little autumn warmth to the garden
Its branches curl around the clearing like hands around a small flame. Beneath its shelter, the youngest shoots drink deeply and grow brave
A low-growing woodland plant with soft, heart-shaped leaves. Morning dew gathers in their shallow folds, glimmering beneath nearby Moonbells.

Honey-gold mushrooms gather in a close, uneven cluster, their rounded caps sheltering smaller buttons below. Cream-coloured gills peek beneath the pale rims, while slender stems deepen to warm brown at their feet. Hidden beneath the woodland floor, fine fungal threads form quiet partnerships with nearby roots.
Thick, blue-green leaves spread from a tightly furled center, overlapping like plates of armor.
cream coloured bark with a few warm, lantern-like seed pods. A birch tree, but it lights up?
Deep green leaves carry a blue satin sheen that shifts as the light moves across their uneven surfaces
Pearl-white bells nod above the woodland floor. Beside a heartleaf, every passing footstep seems to wake another silver drop.
Curved trunk, cascading silver-green foliage and tiny crescent-shaped leaves
Broad-crowned oak with sculpted branches, grouped foliage and softly veined early leaves.
Slender stems carry orange papery husks, each enclosing a small berry like a secret inside a lantern
Gracefully arching stems carry paired oval leaves above a row of creamy hanging bells. Each flower ends in a pale jade tip, like a pearl dipped in green.
Long, undivided green fronds rise in a loose crown, their softly rippled edges folding like ribbons

Fine, silver-sage fronds unfold into a delicate crown, their tiny leaflets traced with green and carried on slender plum-coloured stems. Pale fiddleheads curl within its sheltered centre. Beneath the woodland canopy, each passing breeze lifts its layered fronds like softly moving lace
broad, gently domed caps with small star shaped markings. Do not eat.

A compact tuft of arching, blue-green leaves supporting three flower spikes at uneven heights. Each spike resembles a rounded little torch, grading from buttery yellow at its base to warm orange at its tip.
Its slender blades rise in a sweeping crest, bright green with silvery edges. Dew gathers along their tips, scattering little flashes of light as each passing breeze sends a ripple through the tuft.
Delicate ivory flowers float above a low skirt of divided leaves. Their softly curled petals seem to follow a breeze too gentle for the surrounding plants to feel.

item_definitions.description: A rounded straw hive on a wooden stand, with a honey pot and drinking saucer. +3% garden attraction while placed. Gentle honey drip.
A midnight-blue garden gnome etched with stars and nebulae. Celestial Welcome gives +4.5% garden attraction while placed.
A reel-tethered kite holds a tiny floating cloud. Gentle six-second wind loop. Gentle Hold extends butterfly welcome time by 20% while placed.
A crooked wooden sign with Home, Somewhere and a scratched-out third direction. Static cosmetic item. No skill.
A warm clay kiln with flickering green foxfire and three unfinished acorn cups on its drying shelf. Cosmetic; no gameplay skill.
A hollow-log lending library with bark-bound books and a full-moon return sign. Borrowed Wisdom gives +1% activity water per distinct planted species, capped at +5%.
A curved charcoal-iron lamppost with softly glowing amber panes. Static, cosmetic decoration; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A fungal switchboard with seed-husk receivers and traveling light pulses. Sporeline Surge gives all planted plants +4% water from workouts while placed.
A faded blanket, a well-loved basket, and two mugs waiting for their owners. A little rest leaves room for another adventure.
A curved wooden harp with seven sky-reflecting droplets. Morning Rain gives each planted plant +2.5 water at the start of each game day.
A three-tined iron pitchfork with a honey-wood handle and tan wrapped grip. Static and cosmetic; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A slumped scarecrow beneath an oversized straw hat, with one bird nesting in its pocket. Static cosmetic item. No skill.
A shell-roof woodland mailbox with leaf letters and a waiting parcel. +5% offline visitor storage capacity while placed.
A smooth warm-grey stone birdbath with still jade water and one carved woodland bird. Static and cosmetic; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
a basic bench, allows weary travelers to find rest in your garden
